name: Gramma Stonefield
summary: At the Stonefield farm in Elwynn, Gramma Stonefield works quietly to ease a family feud.

sections.title: A Secret Peacemaker
sections.body: For decades, the Stonefields and Maclures have bickered across the road. Gramma Stonefield, the oldest living member of her clan, sees their rivalry as senseless and harmful. So when her grandson Tommy Joe Stonefield falls in love with Maybell Maclure, she chooses compassion over clan loyalty. She turns to her old friend William Pestle in Goldshire and quietly plans ways for the sweethearts to meet in secret despite the hostility between their farms.

faq.answer: Gramma Stonefield, whose given name is Mildred, is the elderly matriarch of the Stonefield family at their farm in Elwynn Forest. She is Tommy Joe Stonefield's grandmother.

faq.q: How does she feel about the feud with the Maclures?
faq.answer: Mildred wants no part in the feud with the Maclures. She sees the grudge as foolish and harmful, and would rather the households live in harmony than keep bickering.

faq.q: Why is she helping Tommy Joe and Maybell?
faq.answer: Mildred loves her grandson Tommy Joe and wants him to be happy. She rejects the family feud and asks her old friend William Pestle to devise a solution for Tommy Joe's romance with Maybell Maclure.

faq.q: Who is William Pestle to her?
faq.answer: William Pestle is an old, trusted friend of Gramma Stonefield. He lives at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, where he works as an alchemist. She sends trusted couriers to ask him for remedies and other help for Tommy Joe.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you can see how local conflicts in the heartland call for quiet diplomacy and empathy.
